name: Fresh-corn porridge
summary: Cháo bẹ is porridge from fresh young corn flour on the northern route. A contest note names cháo bẹ rau măng and does not describe it. A price is Check on arrival.
howToEat: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 says cháo bẹ is made from fresh young corn flour. The ministry’s 22 August 2024 contest note names cháo bẹ rau măng and does not describe it.
A price is Check on arrival.
where: Northern-route kitchens, on the 22 March 2023 article.
seoTitle: Fresh-corn porridge on the north road
seoDescription: Cháo bẹ is porridge from fresh young corn flour. A contest note names a bamboo-shoot version and does not describe it. A price is Check on arrival.
